en.khatmGroups.deal.hint: Parts are dealt out in turn once at least two people are in the group, and shared out again when someone new joins. Anyone can give a part back for others to claim.
en.khatmGroups.deal.body: Some parts nobody has started yet can be shared out more evenly. Parts being read or already done stay where they are.
en.khatmGroups.deal.waiting: Parts stay open until someone else joins — then they're dealt out in turn. Invite people below.
